scope: Original spatial adaptations of directly reviewed stills. No copied coordinates or artwork; no inferred reference AI, fill rule, speed or timing. The inherited observation ledger remains unchanged.

references.adaptation: Introduce one nearby landing first, then contrast intermediate returns with a longer direct bridge. This early geometry adaptation does not qualify the ledger's separate P02 patrol-rich proposal; reconsider or merge that proposal rather than ship duplicate chores.

missions.departureFromReference: One readable keeper and a 30% quota let the natural first enclosure finish the lesson without fractional cleanup. No timer or source HUD percentage is inherited.
Retain the same keeper tier; vary starting position and coverage so the first enclosure changes the useful second return instead of repeating First return.
Start without an authored divider. Creating the line-only divider is the teaching interaction; an occupied region remains on each side.
Replace two long platforms with one generous offset island. The first inner landing teaches a foundation return before combining several platforms.
An asymmetric single-island start contrasts the near perimeter connection with a longer crossing; no new enemy domain is introduced.
Three staggered foundations let the player shorten exposure through successive links or bypass a landing for a larger enclosure.
Define the band as a permanent non-scoring reclaimed foundation, with one catalog keeper in each bay. Choosing which side to work is distinct from constructing the divider in Two keepers.
Original curriculum extension, not a claimed numbered-reference recreation: the same foundation ring supports inward and outward closures, with a keeper in each starting component.
Four offset foundations create a direct bridge versus intermediate-return decision, rather than reproducing two symmetric horizontal strips.
Five non-cross foundations and three known keepers combine link order with region retention. Optional Remix membership is separate from the core Journey.

evidence.scope: Six deterministic complete Solo routes per mission, plus paired-board feasibility checked separately. Privileged offline search is not human pacing, mastery feasibility, enjoyable choice, reference behavior, physical input, Team qualification, or release evidence.

remainingGates: Observe players predict retained regions and explain line-only captures without a dialog.
Verify both advertised alternatives are legible and worthwhile; a single clear route does not prove a meaningful choice.
Verify optional mastery interactions are achievable before an automatic coverage clear.
Measure ordinary completion time and eliminate low-risk cleanup after the distinctive interaction.
Finish original artwork, Journey host adoption, mode qualification, exact-source release gates and public Pages acceptance.
Record final retain, redesign, merge or reject decisions only after the relevant evidence exists.
